name: Should I install countertops or the backsplash first?

mainEntity.name: Should I install countertops or the backsplash first?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should always install the countertops first. Countertops provide the level, stable base that installers use to establish the bottom layout line for the tile. Additionally, installing a backsplash beforehand risks damaging the lower row of tile when heavy stone or quartz slabs are dropped into place. Waiting until countertops are secured ensures a tight, uniform expansion gap that can be cleanly sealed with flexible silicone caulk rather than rigid grout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Always install countertops first to establish a stable reference line and protect the new tile from heavy slab installation damage.
